items.title: Request for `uv.lock` to support different index urls across different developer machines and CI environments
items.reason: Canonical open discussion for installing one lockfile through different index or proxy URLs.

items.title: `uv sync --frozen` ignores all index/mirror configuration and uses hardcoded URLs from `uv.lock`
items.reason: Reports the same frozen-sync behavior, including `UV_DEFAULT_INDEX`; a maintainer confirmed frozen mode intentionally uses URLs recorded in `uv.lock`.

items.title: Support proxy indexes through reversible artifact URLs
items.reason: Implements proxy routing for existing lockfile URLs and explicitly covers frozen installs; it is not yet merged.

related.search_scope: Searched open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged pull requests using literal terms including `UV_DEFAULT_INDEX`, `UV_INDEX_STRATEGY`, `unsafe-any-match`, and `--frozen`; conceptual terms covering mirrors, proxies, lockfile URLs, and index portability; and version/fix-oriented queries. Followed the canonical chain astral-sh/uv#19625 to astral-sh/uv#6349 to astral-sh/uv#20790. Ruled out astral-sh/uv#16996 because it concerns warnings for ignored resolution options, astral-sh/uv#17068 because it concerns required-environment resolution, and astral-sh/uv#20612 because it concerns universal platform resolution.

type_reason: astral-sh/uv#6349 already tracks the same request to install a lockfile through a different index or proxy. The exact frozen-sync behavior was confirmed as intentional in astral-sh/uv#19625: frozen mode performs no resolution and uses concrete artifact URLs from `uv.lock`, so `UV_INDEX_STRATEGY` is not consulted and `UV_DEFAULT_INDEX` does not replace locked URLs. No released fix was found, so this is not a regression.
summary: The exact behavior is intentional today, while portable proxy routing for locked and frozen installs is already tracked in astral-sh/uv#6349 and implemented by the open astral-sh/uv#20790.
draft_response: Thanks for the report. With `--frozen`, uv installs from `uv.lock` without performing resolution, and the lockfile contains the selected registry and artifact URLs. Therefore `UV_INDEX_STRATEGY` is not consulted, and changing `UV_DEFAULT_INDEX` does not replace URLs already recorded in the lockfile. This is the same behavior confirmed in astral-sh/uv#19625. The request to install one lockfile through a different index or proxy is tracked in astral-sh/uv#6349, with an open implementation in astral-sh/uv#20790. I would close this as a duplicate of astral-sh/uv#6349. Until that work is available, generate the lockfile with the index used for the frozen install or allow the sync to update the lockfile when changing indexes.
